zh: n≤1000，O(n²) 可以接受，但直接枚举三元组的 O(n³) 太慢；三个数之和能否被 d 整除只取决于它们模 d 的余数。
固定中间下标 j，再枚举右边的 k，那么左边的 i 所需的余数被唯一确定为 (−arr[j]−arr[k]) mod d。只要知道 j 左边每种余数出现了多少次，就能一次查表得到合法 i 的个数。
开一个长度为 d 的计数数组，先放入 arr[0] 的余数；j 从 1 扫到 n−2，对每个 k>j 把计数数组中所需余数的次数累加到答案，处理完 j 之后再把 arr[j] 的余数计入数组。注意负数取模要调整到 0..d−1，答案用 64 位整数。
en: With n <= 1000, O(n^2) is fine but enumerating all triplets in O(n^3) is too slow; whether three numbers sum to a multiple of d depends only on their remainders modulo d.

Fix the middle index j and enumerate k to its right; then the remainder that i must have on the left is uniquely (-arr[j] - arr[k]) mod d. If you know how many times each remainder occurs to the left of j, a single table lookup gives the number of valid i.

Keep a count array of length d, initially holding the remainder of arr[0]; sweep j from 1 to n-2, and for each k > j add the count of the required remainder to the answer; after finishing j, add arr[j]'s remainder to the array. Normalize negative remainders into 0..d-1 and keep the answer in a 64-bit integer.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Count the first two positions by remainder; modulo d, the third remainder is then uniquely determined. Use combinatorial counting to exclude repeated indices.

## Proof of correctness

When the middle index j is fixed, the frequency array records only the remainders of the elements to the left of j. For each k on the right, the only left remainder needed is -arr[j]-arr[k] (mod d), and a table lookup counts all valid i. Each contribution of a pair j,k corresponds to unique increasing triplets, so the total is exactly the answer.

## Complexity

O(n^2+d), space O(d).
